findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: postcard_check_link_preview, postcard_check_preview_tags · Private data: postcard_check_link_preview · Public sink: postcard_check_link_preview, postcard_check_preview_tags · Destructive: postcard_check_link_preview, postcard_check_preview_tags.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: postcard_check_link_preview, postcard_check_preview_tags · Private data: postcard_check_link_preview · Public sink: postcard_check_link_preview, postcard_check_preview_tags · Destructive: postcard_check_link_preview, postcard_check_preview_tags

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
